name: 44114 · Cleveland, OH
findings: ZIP 44114 (Cleveland) has 323 nonprofit organizations. 117 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 106 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44114 (Cleveland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44114 (Cleveland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 106 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
